184:     """Decode complete JSON values/lines, never digest-containing substrings."""
185:     values = []
186:     def visit(item, depth):
187:         need(depth <= 24, "CAPTURE_STRUCTURE_DEPTH")
188:         if type(item) is dict:
189:             values.append(item)
190:             for child in item.values(): visit(child, depth + 1)
191:         elif type(item) is list:
192:             for child in item: visit(child, depth + 1)
193:         elif type(item) is str:
194:             texts = [item] + item.splitlines() if "\n" in item else [item]
195:             seen = set()
196:             for text in texts:
197:                 text = text.strip()
198:                 if text in seen or not text.startswith(("{", "[")): continue
199:                 seen.add(text)
200:                 try: parsed = strict(text)
201:                 except (ValueError, TypeError): continue
202:                 if type(parsed) in (dict, list): visit(parsed, depth + 1)
203:     visit(value, 0)
204:     return values
